description: This file contains initialization, configuration, and helper functions for testing the gitweb CGI application. It sets up environment variables, writes configuration Perl scripts, and includes test setup routines.

methods.name: gitweb_init
methods.description: Initializes environment variables, writes a Perl configuration file, and sets the script name for the gitweb CGI application.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Executes the gitweb CGI script with specified GET parameters, capturing output and headers for testing purposes.
